description: This file contains utility functions for encoding and decoding EBML elements used in WebM media processing, including bit manipulation and length encoding functions.

methods.name: numberOfTrailingZeros32
methods.description: Calculates the number of trailing zeros in a 32-bit integer using a lookup table.

methods.name: highestOneBit
methods.description: Finds the highest one bit in a 64-bit integer.

methods.name: _powerOf2
methods.description: Returns the power of two less than or equal to the input.

methods.name: numberOfTrailingZeros
methods.description: Calculates the number of trailing zeros in a 64-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: encodeUnsigned
methods.description: Encodes an unsigned integer into EBML variable-length format.

methods.name: encodeUnsigned
methods.description: Encodes an unsigned integer with specified width into EBML format.

methods.name: sizeOf
methods.description: Calculates the size in bytes of an EBML encoded id or size.

methods.name: serializeCodedUnsigned
methods.description: Serializes an EBML encoded id or size into big-endian byte array.
